elements.text:
You are looking through your social media app and see a number of your friends have posted to their stories. As you look through their photos, you realize that a few of your close friends were all hanging out without you. 

Here are some feelings that might happen in the moment:

texts: I worry that they left me out on purpose, but remember all of the times I have been included.
I'm feeling sad, but decide to think of the good times I have had with my friends.
I'm sad that they forgot about me.
I'm calm seeing the pictures that they posted.
I'm glad that I have such cool friends.
